filtersOrSort: fixed to the CAC service's generic timeline template — getCacTimeline() takes no id/params, so this is not per-application, just the four canned stages shown on the service detail page before applying

payload.name: nature
payload.type: string (one of the client-side NATURE_OPTIONS list)

authContext.note: Neither file in scope calls creatorGates() or checks accountType/subscriptionPaid/kyc — this flow is presented as available to any authenticated user (creator or otherwise), not gated behind a creator-only check. Auth itself is assumed (no anonymous/logged-out branch rendered), consistent with the app-wide (app) route group.

special.uploadsNote: apply/page.tsx has three document slots (Valid ID, Signature, Passport photograph). 'Take a photo' / 'Choose file' buttons call addPassportPhoto(), which never opens a real file picker or reads real bytes — it just flips doc state to 'uploading' then 'uploaded' after a setTimeout with a hardcoded filename/size. The signature doc similarly auto-completes via a setInterval progress simulation (STUB-6). No real upload endpoint exists anywhere in services.ts/mocks/services.ts for these three documents — only the final payCacApplication payload (names/nature/registrationType) is SEAM-tagged; the documents themselves are never sent to the mock API layer at all.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: getService("cac") resolves to null on the CAC detail page, rendering ErrorState
uiStatesHandled.note: The route is hardcoded to id "cac" and MOCK_SERVICES always contains a "cac" entry, so this branch cannot currently occur; only reachable in production if a real backend's /api/hub/services/:id ever omitted the cac service.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: both getService("cac") and getCacTimeline() resolve successfully (default/only path on the server-rendered detail page)
a ServiceApplicationTimeline entry has status 'done' (renders a filled check circle)
uiStatesHandled.note: MOCK_CAC_TIMELINE's four entries are status 'current' then three 'upcoming' — no entry is ever 'done', so the done-styled branch in page.tsx is dead code against current mock data.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: a ServiceApplicationTimeline entry has status 'current' (shows the 'In progress' StatusPill)
a ServiceApplicationTimeline entry has status 'upcoming' (numbered, muted)
default state on entering /services/cac/apply, or navigating back via step rail/Edit
user clicks Continue on step 1 while validateNames() returns >=1 error (empty name, 'Ltd' on a business_name registration, restricted words, duplicate names)
step === 2; each of the three doc slots independently renders empty / uploading (with % + progress bar) / uploaded
uiStatesHandled.note: Reachable, but the underlying upload itself is simulated end-to-end (see special.uploadsNote / STUB-6) — no doc state ever reflects a real network call.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: !allDocsUploaded (at least one of the three docs is not yet in 'uploaded' state)
step === 3; recap of type/names/nature/doc-count with per-row Edit links back to step 1 or 2
confirmed === true and payAndSubmit() is called; payPhase set to 'processing' while payCacApplication() is in flight (button shows loading)
payCacApplication() resolves with result !== 'success', or the call throws
uiStatesHandled.note: payMockCacApplication() in mocks/services.ts is hardcoded to always return { result: "success", ... } after a fixed delay and never throws — the ServicePaymentResult union includes 'payment_failed' and the UI fully renders a retry banner ('Your bank didn't confirm the payment...') for it, but nothing in the mock data layer can currently produce that outcome.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: payCacApplication() resolves with result === 'success'; shows reference/amountPaid/certificateExpectedBy and Track it / Back to services actions

uiStatesDesigned.state: Service detail — live service (apply, review, access)
Tracking an application (submitted done / under review current / certificate ready upcoming)
Apply step 2 — Documents (one done, one uploading, one waiting)
Apply step 3 — Review and submit, every row editable
Apply step 1 — Validation errors (each error says what to do)
Apply submitted — reference, cost, refund rule (success)

uiStatesDesignedNote: No design frame depicts a payment-failed/retry state for CAC apply, and none depicts the CAC service-not-found error state — both exist only in the code (apply_pay_failed, service_not_found), consistent with those being the two states also marked reachable:"no" above.
